title: Consumption-investment under alternative stochastic-integral conventions
abstract: arXiv:2602.08527v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the Merton consumption-investment problem when risky asset dynamics are written under stochastic-integral conventions indexed by $\alpha$, interpolating between the It\^o ($\alpha=0$), Stratonovich ($\alpha=1/2$), and H\"anggi-Klimontovich ($\alpha=1$) conventions. Transforming the drift jointly with the convention leaves the optimal policy unchanged; holding the drift coefficient numerically fixed changes the investor's opportunity set. Under logarithmic utility, consumption is unaffected while the optimal portfolio weight shifts by $\alpha V^{-1}d_V$; for a Heston asset, $\pi_t^\ast=\alpha+(\mu-r+\alpha\varrho\xi/2)/V_t$, which can change sign across volatility states. Identifying the convention from return data alone is impossible without additional structural restrictions.

translated_title: 不同随机积分约定下的消费-投资问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究了Merton消费-投资问题，其中风险资产动态以由参数 $\alpha$ 索引的随机积分约定书写，该约定在Itô（$\alpha=0$）、Stratonovich（$\alpha=1/2$）和Hänggi-Klimontovich（$\alpha=1$）约定之间插值。当漂移随约定一同变换时，最优策略保持不变；而当漂移系数在数值上固定不变时，投资者的机会集则会改变。在对数效用下，消费不受影响，而最优组合权重发生 $\alpha V^{-1}d_V$ 的偏移；对于Heston资产，$\pi_t^\ast=\alpha+(\mu-r+\alpha\varrho\xi/2)/V_t$，其符号可能随波动率状态而改变。在没有额外结构性限制的情况下，仅凭收益数据无法识别所采用的约定。
tldr: 本文将Merton消费-投资问题推广到由参数α索引的随机积分约定族（介于Itô与Hänggi-Klimontovich约定之间），证明漂移随约定联合变换时最优策略不变，但对数效用下最优组合权重偏移αV⁻¹d_V且可能随波动率状态变号，且仅凭收益数据无法识别所用约定。
en_tdlr: The Merton consumption-investment problem is invariant when the drift is transformed jointly with the stochastic-integral convention, but under log utility the optimal portfolio weight shifts by αV⁻¹d_V, and the convention cannot be identified from return data alone.
